name: application-badges
title: Badges
description: Small inline labels for communicating status, counts, categories, and metadata in application interfaces.
useWhen: Annotating items with a status, category, or count that does not require its own element.
Displaying notification counts or activity indicators on navigation items.
Labeling table rows or list items with a discrete state such as active, pending, or archived.
avoidWhen: The label is the primary content rather than metadata attached to something else.
More than three or four badges appear in a cluster — use a tag input or filter bar instead.
The badge communicates an error or warning that requires user action — use an alert instead.
responsiveBehavior: Badges are inline and scale with surrounding text. Ensure sufficient tap target size when badges are interactive on touch devices.
accessibility: Do not rely on color alone to convey status — pair each color with a visible text label.
Icon-only badges must include a visually-hidden text label or aria-label for screen readers.
Dismiss buttons need an accessible label that names what is being removed.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Pill-shaped badges in solid and outlined styles for neutral category labels and counts.
accessibility: Text label is always visible; color is supplementary.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Pill-shaped solid and outlined badges adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark foreground and border colors maintain WCAG AA contrast.

variants.title: Base with icon
variants.description: Pill badges with a small leading icon for adding visual context to a category or status label.
accessibility: Icons are decorative when the text label already communicates the meaning.

variants.title: Base with icon (Dark)
variants.description: Icon-prefixed pill badges adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Icons are decorative when the text label already communicates the meaning.

variants.title: Base with dismiss
variants.description: Removable tag-style badges with a close button, suitable for applied filters and selected categories.
accessibility: Dismiss button must have an aria-label that identifies the tag being removed.
Focus returns to a logical position in the document after dismissal.

variants.title: Base with dismiss (Dark)
variants.description: Removable tag badges with a close button adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dismiss button must have an aria-label that identifies the tag being removed.

variants.title: Icon only
variants.description: Compact circular badges showing only an icon, for space-constrained notification indicators.
accessibility: Requires aria-label or visually-hidden text to describe the badge to screen reader users.

variants.title: Icon only (Dark)
variants.description: Compact circular icon-only badges adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Requires aria-label or visually-hidden text to describe the badge to screen reader users.

variants.title: Themed with icon
variants.description: Semantic color badges — green for success, yellow for warning, red for error — each with a matching icon.
accessibility: Color conveys semantic meaning; always pair with a text label so colorblind users are not excluded.

variants.title: Themed with icon (Dark)
variants.description: Semantic success, warning, and error badges with matching icons adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Color conveys semantic meaning; always pair with a text label so colorblind users are not excluded.
